    Mesh relations along a covering ℤΔ → Q #

    The general form of SectionalMesh: for any covering π : ℤΔ → Q commuting with translation, pulling the coefficients of Q back along π makes π map the mesh relation at X to the mesh relation at π X, so π preserves the mesh ideal. This is how the twisted trace calculation (Lemma A.2) passes relations downstairs.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
